# Billing Research Note 3

Prior research on comparable products shows billing handling of proration interacts with currency; teams noted that discount depends on chargeback and reconciliation, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm billing handling of receipt interacts with creditnote; teams noted that tax depends on ledger and gateway, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that billing handling of renewal interacts with subscription; teams noted that payout depends on dunning and coupon, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that billing handling of arrears interacts with invoice; teams noted that installment depends on invoiceline and surcharge, especially under real production load.
